title: No description available on usage of enum keys despite documentation comments
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439] ### System information Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9174) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.91 GiB memory ### Issue description After adding documentation comments on a named enum and its keys in GDScript script that's added to a Node3D, the script editor shows "No description available" when hovering over a usage of said enum key. I expect to see the documentation comment that's added to the script to appear in this description box, as it does for the enum itself. ### Steps to reproduce Add the following code to a script that inherits from Node3D, then hover over the "ONE" part in `TestEnum.ONE`. It should show a textbox about the value, with "No description available" underneath (as seen in the screenshot in Issue description). ```gdscript extends Node3D ## This is a test enum enum TestEnum { ## Value of one ONE = 1, ## Value of two TWO = 2, ## Value of three THREE = 3 } @export var test_value: TestEnum = TestEnum.ONE; ``` ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) While there is an MRP ([bug_test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25110338/bug_test.zip)), I first noticed this issue in the main project I'm working on. The issue is identical in both that project and this MRP.
